verdict.rationale: Steel publishes an API reference: the docs invite users to 'Explore API endpoints' for captchas, credentials and files, an OpenAPI spec is served at docs.steel.dev/openapi.json, and a community member praised the 'docs + api ref'. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it or runnable request execution in the API reference, documented runnable code examples per endpoint, hands-on corroboration of interactivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Explore API endpoints for building on Steel.
